explanation: The 8 subarrays with product less than 100 are [10], [5], [2], [6], [10,5], [5,2], [2,6], [5,2,6]. Note that [10,5,2] is not included because its product is 100, which is not strictly less than 100.
No product of positive integers can be less than 0, so there are no valid subarrays.
The only subarray is [1], with product 1, which is less than 2.
